image_description: An underwater shot looking up towards the surface, capturing the silhouette of a hammerhead shark swimming overhead. The sun is shining through the water on the left, creating strong backlighting and glare. The shark's distinctive T-shaped head (cephalofoil) is clearly visible in profile against the light. Several smaller fish are visible in the background near the surface.
